description: Per-base phyloP and phastCons conservation of the LRIT2 isoform 2 micro-exon versus flanking constitutive exons and intron
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
API="https://api.genome.ucsc.edu/getData/track"
def track(tr,chrom,s,e):
    r=requests.get(API,params=dict(genome="hg38",track=tr,chrom=chrom,start=s,end=e),timeout=120)
    r.raise_for_status(); return r.json()

regions = {
 "micro-exon (iso2-specific, 30 nt)": (84222827, 84222857),
 "constitutive exon 2 last 60 nt":    (84224333, 84224393),
 "constitutive exon 3 first 60 nt":   (84222620, 84222680),
 "intron control 300 nt (upstream)":  (84223200, 84223500),
}
def vals(js, s, e, tr):
    arr=np.full(e-s, np.nan)
    d=js["phyloP100way"] if tr=="phyloP100way" else js["phastCons100way"]
    items = d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get("chr10",[])
    for it in items:
        st=it.get("start"); en=it.get("end"); v=it.get("value")
        if st is None: continue
        for p in range(max(st,s),min(en,e)): arr[p-s]=v
    return arr

res={}
for tr in ["phyloP100way","phastCons100way"]:
    print("="*60); print(tr)
    for nm,(s,e) in regions.items():
        try:
            js=track(tr,"chr10",s,e); a=vals(js,s,e,tr)
            res[(tr,nm)]=a
            print(f"  {nm:<36} n={np.sum(~np.isnan(a)):>4}  mean={np.nanmean(a):+.3f}  median={np.nanmedian(a):+.3f}  max={np.nanmax(a):+.3f}")
        except Exception as ex:
            print(f"  {nm}: FAILED {type(ex).__name__} {str(ex)[:120]}")

# statistical comparison: micro-exon vs intron control
from scipy import stats
for tr in ["phyloP100way","phastCons100way"]:
    me=res.get((tr,"micro-exon (iso2-specific, 30 nt)")); ic=res.get((tr,"intron control 300 nt (upstream)"))
    ce=res.get((tr,"constitutive exon 2 last 60 nt"))
    if me is None: continue
    me,ic,ce=[x[~np.isnan(x)] for x in (me,ic,ce)]
    u1=stats.mannwhitneyu(me,ic,alternative="greater")
    u2=stats.mannwhitneyu(me,ce,alternative="less")
    print(f"\n{tr}: micro-exon vs intron  U p={u1.pvalue:.2e} (micro-exon more conserved?)")
    print(f"{tr}: micro-exon vs constitutive exon  U p={u2.pvalue:.2e} (micro-exon less conserved?)")
    print(f"   means: micro-exon {me.mean():+.3f} | intron {ic.mean():+.3f} | constitutive exon {ce.mean():+.3f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.3))
for ax,tr,lab in zip(axes,["phyloP100way","phastCons100way"],["phyloP (100-way)","phastCons (100-way)"]):
    dat=[res[(tr,n)][~np.isnan(res[(tr,n)])] for n in regions]
    bp=ax.boxplot(dat,labels=["iso2\nmicro-exon","constitutive\nexon 2 end","constitutive\nexon 3 start","intron\ncontrol"],
                  patch_artist=True, showfliers=False)
    for p,c in zip(bp["boxes"],["crimson","steelblue","steelblue","lightgrey"]): p.set_facecolor(c); p.set_alpha(.7)
    for i,d in enumerate(dat,1):
        ax.scatter(np.random.normal(i,0.06,len(d)),d,s=5,color="black",alpha=.35,zorder=3)
    ax.set_ylabel(lab); ax.set_title(f"LRIT2 locus {lab} per base",fontsize=10)
    ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=.7,ls="--")
plt.suptitle("The LRIT2 isoform 2 micro-exon is as conserved as the flanking constitutive exons",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
